Millennium Falcon Lego Set:
The Millennium Falcon is one of the most iconic spaceships in the Star Wars universe, and now you can build your own with this Lego set. The set includes Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Qi’ra minifigures, as well as a buildable Millennium Falcon ship. The ship features a cockpit for the minifigures to sit in, rotating top and bottom gun turrets, and a removable top hull for easy access to the detailed interior. The set also includes a chicken leg element, a fun nod to a memorable scene in Solo: A Star Wars Story.

Master Builders:
The Master Builders are a group of Lego minifigures that appear in The Lego Movie and The Lego Movie 2. These minifigures have the unique ability to build anything out of Lego bricks without the need for instructions. It is shown that the Master Builders meet in the “Dog” part of Cloud Cuckoo Land to discuss various issues.

Establishment of a Website and Premises for the Horizon Compensation Advisory Board (HCAB):
The terms of reference for the establishment of a website and premises for the HCAB are as follows:

1. Understand and acknowledge what went wrong and key lessons that must be learned.
2. Obtain all available relevant evidence from the Post Office, Fujitsu, BEIS and any other relevant sources.
3. Set out the terms of reference for the HCAB, including its purpose, scope, and responsibilities.
4. Identify the skills and expertise required for HCAB membership and establish a process for appointing members.
5. Establish a secretariat to support the HCAB and ensure that it has the resources required to carry out its work.
6. Develop a communications strategy to ensure that the work of the HCAB is transparent and accessible to all stakeholders.
7. Establish a process for monitoring and reporting on the work of the HCAB.
